scripts.postinstall: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('npm --workspace @oglasi/database run db:generate', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (_) { process.exit(0); }"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --workspace oglasi-klient run dev" "npm --workspace oglasi-admin run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm --workspace oglasi-klient run build && npm --workspace oglasi-admin run build
scripts.build:vercel: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const url = ((process.env.VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL || '') + (process.env.VERCEL_URL || '')).toLowerCase(); try { execSync('npm --workspace @oglasi/database run db:generate', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (_) {} if (url.includes('admin')) { execSync('npm --workspace oglasi-admin run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { execSync('npm --workspace oglasi-klient run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); if (process.env.VERCEL === '1') { execSync('npm run build:vercel', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { try { execSync('npm --workspace @oglasi/database run db:generate', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (_) {} execSync('npm run build:all', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
